assertions: 15 CFP lessons (128 steps) and 8 Sigma lessons (30 steps) completed through rendered hinted controls at both widths
Cover removal alone does not enter level 3; actual SW8 enters coincidence and cycles the nine source functions
Refitting the cover retains active engineering state and hides SW8; reopening exposes the same state
Next Option selects immediately in L3; Enable/Disable stages a pair; a subsequent Next Option commits it
One coincidence zone indicates fire and buzzer but does not run alarm sounders; both zones permit normal output
Actual open/short scenario selectors retain subtype; matching diagnostic function shows only the affected zone
VR1 exposes 1 through 10 minutes; stored 3-minute setting, delayed Z1 and test Z5 persist
Zoomed physical key targets are at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels; no horizontal document overflow in fit or zoom
CFP manual modal excludes Sigma documents; normal download/read flow renders source PDF in canvas
Prior old-schema CFP disablement and completion are retained before intentional practice; Sigma remains exactly unchanged by CFP use
Prior synthetic visit, schedule and intruder state remain byte-equivalent by JSON comparison; prior saved PDF remains stored
After a complete app cache, network-disabled reload retains active L3, unconfirmed draft, fitted cover, settings, test flags and lesson completions
With networking disabled, both CFP and earlier Gent saved PDFs render; prior visit can be reopened
No browser page errors in either run
limits: Desktop Chromium viewport emulation, not physical iPhone Safari or panel hardware verification
All site/event/programming data are labelled synthetic; no real panel was connected
CFP PDF API response is intercepted with the checked local installation manual bytes to avoid depending on manufacturer host availability
Old visit/import/intruder records are preservation markers; their full product workflows are covered by separate feature suites
This report verifies the local app, not publication or APK signing
Unconfirmed draft exit handling is labelled simulator policy because the manual does not specify every firmware edge case
